ci-bot: NIGHTLY PERF ALERT: job=nightly-perf-ci; check=small-batch-throughput; model=rw7b-quant; p99 latency +22% vs baseline. Details: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/3481239876 :rotating_light:

nora: seeing that on grafana too — p99 spike lines up with the nightly window. graphed here: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/nightly-perf?orgId=1&from=now-2h :eyes:

sam: i'm oncall for the window. pulling logs now. can someone drop the artifact link and the exact test params?

ci-bot: test params: seq_len=1024, batch_size=8, model_variant=rw7b-quant, dataset=nightly-smoke. Artifacts available at https://artifacts.redwood/internal/3481239876

kai: note: we rolled `adaptive_batcher_v2` to 30% canary two days ago. could be related to batching behavior for these seq/batch combos.

matt: i'll start a quick bisect to revert that flag in canary and re-run the nightly job. if repros, i'll collect perf traces.

liz: if bisect shows a regression, we should pin the default back to v1 for hosted until we have a plan. not ready for broad roll.

nora: context: the nightly runner reuses warm processes; i'm seeing more KV-cache evictions around the same timestamps. that could increase token gen latency on p99.

sam: grabbing `strace` + heap profile from the failing run, uploading now. command i ran: ```perf-collect --run 3481239876 --out /tmp/artifacts``` then scp to the artifacts bucket.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary rollback of feature/adaptive_batcher_v2 by matt. Track: https://deploys.redwood/internal/deploys/rollback-3481239876

matt: rollback applied to canary, re-triggering nightly-perf job: https://ci.redwood.internal/runs/3481239999 (manual trigger)

ci-bot: re-run finished: p99 delta now +3% vs baseline (was +22%). Small improvement but not fully back to baseline. Full logs: https://artifacts.redwood/internal/3481239999

kai: partial rollback explains partial improvement — some pods still on v2 in other AZs for capacity testing. i'll coordinate to drain them and re-check scheduling knobs (kernel and runtime batching telemetry).

nora: next steps: 1) extend the smoke run for 12h to look for recurrence, 2) add KV-cache hit/miss tag to the nightly telemetry, 3) sam to attach perf traces, 4) matt to finish full rollback if results hold. Assigning: @sam (artifact collection), @matt (bisect + rollback), @kai (runtime/log analysis).

sam: ack :thumbsup: uploading full traces to the artifacts link now.

matt: will follow up with a PR to pin default to v1 if rollback confirms. ETA ~3h.

nora: thanks everyone. if p99 goes >10% again, escalate to paging. I'll keep this thread updated as I watch the extended run.

liz: thanks — and please add any knobs/flags you flip to the rollback PR so product/ops have the record.

matt: noted, will include changelog and perf screenshots.

sam: adding one quick note — while collecting traces I saw a short period (00:23-00:27) where kernel preemption counters jump. i'm dumping that slice to the artifact bundle.

nora: good catch. that might explain the tail. ok — hands off for now, monitoring.
